caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet, crafted with fine detail. The bonnet is rendered in shades of light brown, tan, and beige. The main body of the bonnet is structured and oval-shaped, with visible vertical and diagonal ribbed stitching patterns. The brim is firm and rounded at the front, gradually tapering toward the more gathered back section. A separate, gathered section of softer fabric is attached to the back of the bonnet, with the material forming pronounced folds and ruffles. Two fabric ties hang loosely from the lower left side of the bonnet, each ending in a slight point with finishing details. The illustration is done on an off-white background and is signed at the lower right.
title: Sun Bonnet
